overview.title: Feedback
overview.description: Manage all your agents' feedback in one place.
overview.empty: No feedback in this workspace yet.
overview.curationDescription: Aggregated agent feedback per element — what works, what needs care.

unused.title: Unused
unused.description: Active elements no agent has used or rated yet.
unused.empty: All active elements are in use.

delete.label: Delete
delete.dialogDescription: The feedback on “{{name}}” will be permanently deleted along with its triage history. This cannot be undone.
delete.dialogDescriptionGeneric: This feedback will be permanently deleted along with its triage history. This cannot be undone.

report.label: Report a problem
report.dialogDescription: Report a problem with the platform itself (technical or with the MCP) — it lands in the feedback inbox where it can be triaged.
report.notePlaceholder: What happened? Which tool/page, expected vs. actual?

give.title: Give feedback
give.description: Tell us how “{{name}}” works in practice — your signal lands in curation and helps keep the element in shape.
give.notePlaceholder: What did you notice? (e.g. “deadlines are outdated”)

detail.description: Feedback curation — usage, signals and individual events for this element.
detail.empty: No feedback for this element yet.
detail.negativeHint: Several signals report problems. A revised version could fix this.
detail.notePlaceholder: Capture a note (e.g. “update deadlines to 30 days”)…
detail.noteNoOpen: Notes attach to an open signal — there is none right now.

itemDetail.description: Every detail about this feedback — reference, signal, status and history.
itemDetail.title: {{signal}} · {{name}}
itemDetail.statusHint: Change the handling state — every change lands in the history.

list.title: External tools
list.description: MCP server bindings with a stable capability alias — maintain once, stay current everywhere.
list.emptyDescription: Add your first external tool (e.g. Todoist) to reference it by alias in playbooks and personas.

new.title: New external tool
new.description: Create a new MCP server binding.

form.identityDescription: What the tool is called and which alias it is referenced by.
form.identityHelp: Example: "Todoist" with alias "todo" — playbooks/personas reference the alias, not the concrete tool. Swapping the tool (e.g. Todoist → Things 3) updates every referencing prompt automatically.
form.aliasHelp: Stable capability alias (e.g. "todo") for the tool-ref reference in playbooks/personas. Derived from the name on create and immutable afterwards.
form.mcpServerNameHelp: Display name of the connector in the agent runtime.
form.toolNamesPlaceholder: Enter tool name and press Enter
form.toolNamesHelp: Relevant MCP tool identifiers (e.g. add_task, list_tasks). Press Enter to add, click X to remove.
form.usageNotesDescription: When and how the agent should use this tool.
form.usageNotesHelp: Do/don't, typical use cases. Included in the prompt when the tool-ref expands.
form.fallbackNotePlaceholder: What the agent should do when the server is not connected
form.fallbackNoteHelp: Optional. Applies when the MCP server is not connected in the runtime.
form.tagsHelp: Press Enter to add, click X to remove.

detail.bannerDraftDescription: Submit it for review when you are done.
detail.bannerReviewDescription: Activate it after review, or send it back to draft.
detail.bannerInactiveDescription: Reactivate it as a draft to keep working on it.

delete.viewerReadOnly: Viewers can only view external tools
delete.blockedMessage: This tool is still used by:
delete.dangerZoneDescription: Permanently removes this tool and all its versions. No undo.

list.title: Work area
list.description: What your agents have collected and filed. Unversioned and deliberately separate from resources — this is raw material, not published content.
list.emptyDescription: Private areas appear automatically as soon as an agent files something for the first time. Shared areas are created here and then granted to individual agents.

new.title: Create shared area
new.description: Shared areas can be granted to several agents.
new.retentionHelp: After this period the nightly sweep removes older content of this area. Leave empty for: nothing is deleted automatically.
new.retentionInvalid: Please enter a whole number greater than 0.
new.viewerReadOnly: As a viewer you cannot create areas.

detail.privateNoticeDescription: This area belongs to exactly one agent. “Private” means private towards other agents — as a human you still see it. There are no grants here; use a shared area for that.
detail.notFound: This area does not exist or is not visible to you.

artifacts.title: Content
artifacts.emptyDescription: As soon as an agent files something here, it shows up in this list.

artifact.emptyBody: This item has no text content.
artifact.rawNotice: Shown unformatted: the content comes from agents and ingested external sources and is deliberately not rendered as markdown.
artifact.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{title}}” permanently? This cannot be undone.
artifact.viewerReadOnly: As a viewer you cannot delete anything.

grants.title: Access
grants.description: Which agent may read or write this area. Humans grant access — agents cannot grant it to themselves.
grants.emptyDescription: Without a grant no agent sees this area.
grants.viewerReadOnly: As a viewer you cannot change grants.

tables.title: Tables in this area
tables.description: Structured data agents have collected in this area. Creating and filling happens via MCP — here you read and export it.
tables.emptyDescription: Agents create tables via MCP, because only the source decides which columns it needs. As soon as one shows up here, you get schema, data and export.
tables.name: Name
tables.schemaDescription: Which columns the table carries and how they are typed.
tables.conventionsDescription: How the source writes units, numbers and dates. Without that note the values would not be comparable — which is why this view deliberately leaves them as they are.
tables.previewNote: Showing the most recent {{limit}} rows out of {{total}}.
tables.previewTruncated: The result was truncated — the table holds more rows than shown here.
tables.previewEmpty: This table holds no rows yet.
tables.notFound: This table does not exist or is not visible to you.

search.title: Search work area
search.description: Finds the relevant passage instead of whole documents — every hit jumps straight into the paragraph.
search.label: Search term
search.promptDescription: The search covers every area you are allowed to see.
search.noResultsDescription: Nothing matches “{{query}}” in the visible areas.

kb.title: Knowledge base
kb.description: Curated statements with evidence. Separate index — no raw work area material shows up here.
kb.label: Search term
kb.promptDescription: Searches the evidence-backed statements of your workspace.

node.title: Statement
node.sourceHelp: Every statement carries mandatory evidence — nothing is created here without a source.
node.sourceArtifactMissing: The referenced content is no longer visible.
node.neighborsEmpty: This statement is not linked to any other.
node.notFound: This statement does not exist or is not visible to you.

workarea.forbidden: You do not have permission for this area.
